sam: quick q — recurring asks from a couple of customers: they want the console to show why requests routed to a fallback and also a small, stable reason string in the API error payload. are we ok adding a 'routing_reason' field to errors?
elaine: prefer a short code (ROUTE_*) + a consumer hint, not raw internal traces. expose too much and we'll leak topology. :thinking:
mike: agree. we should separate 'user_hint' + 'reason_code' from any 'internal_id'. ui can show the hint, console can show aggregated counts of reason_code.
jordan: ops question — telemetry needs route_reason tagging to drill into cases. can we add a metric label `route_reason` and `fallback_depth`? sampling if high-cardinality.
irene: caution: route identifiers are high-cardinality and often contain tenant tags in metadata. we should never surface route_id to customers or put it in a label without hashing/agg.
sam: proposal: error payload shape: ```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "ROUTE_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED",
    "client_hint": "All low-latency backends are busy; try again in a few seconds or use async mode.",
    "metadata": {"fallback_depth": "1"}
  }
}
```
But do NOT include route_id or placement tokens. console would show aggregated rows by `code` with counts & example hint.
elaine: +1. also add HTTP header `x-rw-retryable: true|false` and `x-rw-route-code: ROUTE_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED` for SDKs to make decisions without parsing body.
mike: header is fine but don't over-index on header names — SDKs should default to body first. headers for quick routing/agent logic is ok.
jordan: rollout plan: behind a feature flag `error_reason_exposure_v1` — enable internally -> limited customers opt-in -> safe default off. also require telemetry `route_reason` sampling at 1% for new codes until we vet volumes.
irene: add privacy checklist: ensure no tenant identifiers in `client_hint`, sanitize any example strings, and mark in runbook how to revoke if we accidentally leak something.
sam: question: do we want granular retry guidance in the hint or keep it generic? some customers want specific backoff numbers.
mike: library-level: SDKs can translate `client_hint` into structured guidance (retry-after ms / use async). but payload should remain human readable. structured fields only for internal consumption.
elaine: console UX: show top 3 reason codes per tenant with a small explanation and an example prompt snippet (sanitized). click-to-expand shows sampled raw errors (ops only).
jordan: instrumentation: add tags: `route_reason:ROUTE_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED`, `fallback_depth:1`, `exposed_reason:true|false`. avoid route_id tag.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: staging rollout flag toggle at 2024-06-12T22:00Z -> will run canary at 10% on staging-only clusters.
sam: action items:
- jordan: write RFC for payload + headers + rollout gating (due EOD Thu)
- elaine: console mockups for aggregated view + ops-only detail panel (due next Tue)
- mike: SDK guidance for header/body handling + tests (PR sketch by end of week)
- irene: privacy/runbook checklist + telemetry sampling rules (PT).
Anyone object to that plan? :thumbsup::thumbsdown:
mike: :thumbsup:
jordan: :thumbsup:
elaine: :thumbsup:
irene: :thumbsup:
sam: great, I'll start the RFC skeleton and ping infra for sampling quotas. thanks everyone.
